review: bounded-food-foraging@1 (handler long.bounded-food-foraging, scope long-ex26, learning 1 with no study energy, prerequisites and dependencies navigate, probe, gather and eat, package dependencies foundation-forest@1, foundation-open@1, bounded-resource-search@1, bounded-resource-search-recheck@1, bounded-resource-search-low-health@1 and assess-food-suitability@1, references {} because no parameter names a target, execution duration null with cancel interruption, visualComponents [] with view metadata on every event, no satisfaction rule, process or resource, practiceEvidence its completion event, which never carries a qualified flag, ability text 3485 of 3500 characters) is the general operation bounded food foraging with gather-then-eat for any person whose own eating records support a food kind, a serial controller and not a food source or safety oracle. Versioning: v7Install refuses a repeated ability id or equivalence and nothing supersedes an installed interface, so a new package was added with ability id bounded-food-foraging, equivalence forage:bounded-food-foraging:gather-then-eat:1, event prefix food-foraging- and its own state keys bounded-food-foraging:work:open, :last and :body, each checked unique against every registered package; all 141 earlier packages are byte-identical by an id@version map (digest 9fece11c of the scratch file hashes-before-9.json, taken before this change), including the four reused ones, and long-ex26-search-low-health.ts and long-ex26-food-assessment.ts only gained export blocks of aliases. Reuse, called and not copied: the stop lines are lowHealthRisks of bounded-resource-search-low-health@1 in its low-health mode (health at or below minHealth, any injury of the preceding round other than starvation alone, body temperature 10 or more from 22, minTemp and maxTemp; low satiety never stops it), fed with the health this package keeps under its own key in its own afterEnvironment hook for a person who has mastered it while satiety is 0 or less, the same evidence of starvation alone the low-health search keeps for itself; candidates are searchSources of bounded-resource-search@1 (perceived now through v7Observe at vision 5, or remembered by the person out of view, inside the radius, not made by another person, not left out), called once per eligible kind and merged, then ordered by recheckByGap (nearest reach, then id) across all kinds; pricing is searchFits and searchBinding with the eat added to the chain; the recheck candidates and their once-per-run inspection record follow recheck@1; avoided areas and directions are recheckZones, recheckAvoided and recheckZoned; exploration is searchPlace over observed dry ground; the food judgement is the targetOf, citations and evaluate functions of assess-food-suitability@1, exported unchanged; every step is the dependency handler itself, once per round: v7NavigateStep priced first on a copy of the person (at most speed x dt = 0.8 per round; a faster step or a step that differs from its priced copy throws), open.probe in observe mode, forest.gather of exactly one unit and forest.eat of exactly one owned unit called with interface eat, so eat's own effort, nutrition, toxicity, meal experience, eating record and injury event apply. open-experience.ts adds the interface to the subsistence routine and to the navigate progress check only where bounded-food-foraging@1 is installed, so a foraging eat counts as a manual eat does (tested against the same navigate, probe, gather and eat steps by hand: identical vitals, wellbeing, mood, meal experience, routine, progress and eating record) and every other run replays unchanged. Modeling assumptions: (1) start needs radius (0.5 to 8), path, time (1 to 40 rounds), energy, reserve, quantity (1 to 20 units to eat) and evidenceRefs (1 to 6 of the person's record ids); radius, path, time, energy and quantity must be finite and above 0; the origin is the person's position unless both x and y are given; recheck and explore are off unless given, so exploration is opt-in; (2) the eligible kinds are exactly the cited ids that are the person's own eating records (memory.discoveries, written only by eat) of a known material for which the assessment evaluator returns supported (identity by the person's own eating record of the same kind, nutrition above 0, toxicity 0), never the world's food table or another person's record; every cited id goes through the assessment's own citation, so an unknown id, an undated record (the genesis records carry no round until a real eat dates them) or any other non-record is refused at no cost, and a record that is not cited is not used; eligibility is evaluated again every round, so a record that eat rewrites with harm removes its kind, and a run without any eligible kind stops (safety-unresolved); (3) every other kind seen in the area is reported once per run with the evaluator's verdict (unresolved, or harm-recorded) and its sources, and is never targeted, gathered or eaten, carried units of it included; without a hidden list nothing classifies a seen kind as food or not food, so all such kinds (branches and willow too) are listed as not eaten with their safety unresolved; (4) the reserve is a floor that no step, eating included, spends below, and it is at least 1, the registered energy of eat, so the person keeps enough energy to eat after the run; the energy budget counts every step, eating included, and the run keeps gross energy, rounds, path, gathered units, eaten units and satiety actually gained separately; (5) a candidate fits when the searches' lower-bound pricing of reach (straight-line gap, 0.8 per round, 2 energy per distance), probe (unless just probed) and one gather, plus the eat, fits the path, the time (one more round for the eat), the energy budget and the reserve; each navigate step must also leave the probe, gather and eat after it within the budget and above the reserve; a gather is taken only when it and the eat after it both fit the budget, the reserve and two rounds, and the evaluator supports the source in reach; eat is priced as eat itself prices it, 1 energy divided by the rest factor of mood (1 at neutral mood, more when mood is low), priced again in the eat round, and the spend must equal that price; (6) a unit gathered by the run is eaten in the next round before any further search or gathering; at the start of each round a whole unit the person carries of an eligible kind that the evaluator supports as held (plain, unprocessed) is eaten first; gather always takes one unit; the first gather of each visit follows a probe, and a resume or a new target probes again; (7) it completes at the cap of units eaten, when no permitted candidate or exploration step fits (search-exhausted, possibly with nothing eaten), or when satiety is 100 (nothing to gain; refused at the start); it stops at any limit, the reserve or an unsafe line; with explore, exploration is tried before it stops on known stocked sources that no longer fit; (8) minHealth defaults to 60, is declared and validated in code as 20 to 100, and anything else is refused at no cost; death is health 0 and starvation takes 8 a round, so a run stops above death; (9) one primitive per round; another action pauses it and paused rounds count toward time; resume checks the vitals, the records, the ownership of the gathered unit (a unit no longer carried whole is released and recorded, not replayed) and the stock again; cancel and death end it without refunds; a gathered but uneaten unit stays in the person's inventory under ordinary ownership and death rules, and consumed food stays consumed; (10) no reward: no satisfaction rule or qualified practice evidence; a probe made by the run carries this interface and so earns no confirmed-understanding reward, as in the searches; the meal experience is eat's own (nearby intakes merge into one episode as for manual eating); nothing is created, healed or refunded; (11) view metadata on every event: state (started, searching, observing, gathering, eating, blocked, paused, resumed, stopped, cancelled, completed, ended), run and actor ids, source, item and kind, how the source is known (seen now, remembered with its seen round and past stock, observed ground, probe, gather, eat), the underlying primitive event id, evidenceRefs, measured stock, gathered and eaten flags set only on the event of a committed transfer or eat, the carried unit, a neutral indicator for empty results, the unresolved kinds, minHealth, distance, energy, time and limits. In the archived round-161 world (Lin at health 92, satiety 0, energy 9.89 and body temperature 28.5, her dated berry record of nutrition 8 and toxicity 0, no inventory) Lin can study it in one round (health 84 after it, from starvation alone); a start citing berry is then accepted, but no berry source is in view and every berry source she remembers lies 12 or more away and was last seen empty, so without exploration the run completes in its first round with nothing eaten and lists root, branch, vine, hazelnut, acorn, tuber and willow as seen without an applicable record; with explore (radius 8, path 16, time 20, energy 8.5, reserve 1, quantity 4) a feasible step exists: navigate steps of 0.8, 0.3 and 0.8 toward unseen observed ground while starvation alone takes her health from 84 to 76, 68 and 60, then the default threshold stops it at 60 (with minHealth 20 one more step and then search-exhausted at health 52); no gather and eat fits, and no food is found or assured.
